info.name: Coin Metrics API v4 Blockchain Explorer Job Full catalog API

params.name: assets
params.description: Comma separated list of assets. By default all assets are returned. Supports the following formats: `<asset>` - Coin Metrics asset ticker (e.g., `btc`), `<namespace>:<symbol>` - External provider symbol (e.g., `talos:BTC`), `<namespace>:by-id:<id>` - External provider numeric ID (e.g., `talos:by-id:24`). The `namespace` identifies the external data provider (e.g., `talos`). The `by-id` selector indicates lookup by a provider-specific numeric ID rather than symbol.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to include in response. Supported values are `metrics`, `markets`, `exchanges`. Included by default if omitted.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to exclude from response. Supported values are `metrics`, `markets`, `exchanges`. Included by default if omitted.

items.docs: Returns a list of all supported assets along with information for them like metrics, markets, exchanges and time ranges of available data.

params.name: exchanges
params.description: Comma separated list of exchanges. By default all exchanges are returned. Supports the following formats: `<exchange>` - Coin Metrics exchange name (e.g., `binance`), `<namespace>:<name>` - External provider market name (e.g., `talos:binance`), `<namespace>:by-id:<id>` - External provider numeric market ID (e.g., `talos:by-id:1003`). The `namespace` identifies the external data provider (e.g., `talos`). The `by-id` selector indicates lookup by numeric ID rather than name.

items.docs: Returns a list of all supported exchanges along with available markets for them.

params.description: Comma separated list of markets. By default all markets are returned.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol of derivative markets, full instrument name.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to include in response. Supported values are `trades`, `orderbooks`, `quotes`, `funding_rates`, `openinterest`, `liquidations`. Included by default if omitted.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to exclude from response. Supported values are `trades`, `orderbooks`, `quotes`, `funding_rates`, `openinterest`, `liquidations`. Included by default if omitted.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Supported values are `json`, `json_stream`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit of response items. `none` means no limit. Maximum value is 100.
